# Real data fixture

Extract of the SNCF open data feeds of 4 November 2026 (timetable version
2026-11-03, realtime feeds fetched at 19:46 Paris time): the trains between
Toulouse Matabiau, Saint-Sulpice and Rabastens - Couffouleux, their realtime
updates and the alerts about them. Made with `tests/fixtures/make_real_fixtures.py`.

Source: SNCF Voyageurs, "Réseau SNCF TGV, Intercités et TER",
<https://transport.data.gouv.fr/datasets/horaires-sncf>.
